results.proposal_summary: The AICS (Italian Agency for Development Cooperation), implementing the EU-funded ADAPT programme in Tunisia (AID 12304.01.0 and AID 12769.01.0), has issued a call for proposals (ADAPT/Collecteurs Céréales/2026/1) targeting private cereal collectors and seed producers mandated by Tunisia's Office des Céréales. The call comprises two lots: Lot 1 for consumption cereal collectors and Lot 2 for seed producers. Grants (contributions ADAPT) are provided to selected collectors/seed producers to enable them to offer deferred payment facilities to cereal farmers for purchasing eligible agricultural inputs (seeds, fertilisers, biostimulants) during the 2026/2027 campaign.
